programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: In this two-hour season premiere of Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team, 600 hopeful candidates arrive at Cowboys Stadium for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders preliminary auditions.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Training Camp opens and many of the new candidates have had to uproot their lives and move to Dallas with no guarantee of making it through Training Camp to become a Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: It is just the second week of rehearsals and Kelli and Judy are quick to run the Training Camp Candidates through the signature kick line and jump split.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: In week three of training camp, the rookie candidates are brought in for their DCC makeover. Under the scrutiny of Kelli Finglass, new hairstyles and makeup applications give the girls the DCC look.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: It's week five of training camp and Kelli is out sick. DCC Technical Director, Kitty Carter, fills in and runs the first rehearsal of the week.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Week 7 of training camp begins with a rehearsal on the field at Cowboys Stadium. Kelli and Judy are ready to make final cuts and tonight's rehearsal could determine who makes the squad.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: It's time to announce the DCC squad but first Kelli and Judy put the candidates through a final field rehearsal at Cowboys Stadium. Tensions run high among the girls as Kelli and Judy watch their every step.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The squad has their first game day performance behind them, but after a bad rehearsal, Kelli warns her new team she will cut girls if they don't give 110 percent.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders take a break from the sidelines and travel to Mexico for their annual swimsuit calendar photo shoot.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are in full dance mode preparing for their first regular-season home game performance. Kelli and Judy want the choreography to be perfect and press the girls through a few intense rehearsals.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: In the final episode of the series, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are preparing for their marquee performance - The Susan G. Komen Cancer Awareness Halftime Show during a nationally televised Cowboys football game.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Dreams are on the line as the tryouts for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders 2013-2014 squad begin.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The pressure is mounting as 54 new candidates compete with 32 returning veterans for an invitation into the famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders training camp.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Training camp begins at the Cowboys famous training facility, Valley Ranch. First Meeting is filled with excitement and energy until Kelli calls a special meeting of the veterans.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The "scariest night of training camp" kicks off this dramatic episode as the girls learn the dreaded jumpsplit! It's mind over body, as the girls attempt this famed and required move.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The ladies are really challenged when guest choreographer DJ Guthrie teaches them a new dance style. Kelli and Judy have some tough decisions to make about who will remain on the squad.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The training camp candidates hold their breath as the one and only Kitty Carter pays a visit to training camp. Kitty takes no prisoners as she rips into the new girls as well as the vets.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: With their futures on the line, the training camp candidates try to push through their heightened emotions to show Kelli and Judy they deserve to be part of America's Sweethearts. Unfortunately, for some "Tonight will be your last night".

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: This is it, the last chance, as the girls finally learn their fate. Dreams start coming true as the girls pose for Squad Photo. There is some great dancing as Show Group and the rest of the squad perform for the first time at a new "Meet The Team" event.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes participan en una carrera a gran velocidad en un globo aerostático , pero las apuestas se elevan cuando el Equipo Rocket entra también, ¡causando un caos en las nubes!

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: ¡Cuando un encapuchado deja a un Smoochum con nuestros héroes, esto desenmaraña una historia que los llevará directo a los reflectores de la pantalla de plata!

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Ash y sus amigos son contactados por una ingeniero civil en problemas. Ella tiene un equipo de Pokémon tipo Tierra construyendo un túnel, pero les aterra el agua que se está filtrando. ¿Podrán ayudarlos nuestros héroes?

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: A bordo de un dirigible de lujo, el Equipo Rocket intenta robar algunos objetos de los ricos viajeros, ¡pero unos valientes Kecleon están dispuestos a detenerlos!

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Misty conoce a uno de sus ídolos, una Enfermera Joy especializada en los tipo Agua. Pero la realidad no cumple con sus expectativas cuando la Enfermera Joy revela que no comparte el amor de Misty por los Pokémon acuáticos.

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Ash y sus amigos tienen un último obstáculo antes de Ciudad Olivine, ¡un ardiente desierto! Cuando Cyndaquil se pierde, tiene algo más con que lidiar además del calor.

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: La batalla de Gimnasio de Ash está en marcha cuando es cancelada por Jasmine, la verdadera Líder del Gimnasio Olivine, ¡quien dice que Ash está luchado contra una impostora!

programme.title: Pokémon: Liga de Campeones Johto
programme.desc: Tras recibir medicina en Ciudad Orquídea, nuestros héroes descubren que el Líder de Gimnasio está entrenando duro con su Machoke. ¡Es cuestión de tiempo para que Ash decida enfrentarse con los Pokémon tipo Pelea de Chuck!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: ¡En una riña con el equipo Rocket, Ash y sus amigos caen del barco que los lleva a las Islas Remolino! ¿Podrán escapar de los poderosos remolinos que amenazan con arrastrarlos?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Los Pidgey de una isla protegida no tienen que preocuparse de ser atacados, así que muchos han perdido el interés en volar. ¡Pero uno de ellos aún sueña con volar más allá de las estrellas! ¿Podrán ayudarlo Ash y sus amigos?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes pasan por una aldea de montaña a tiempo para la migración anual de Chinchou. Los aldeanos siempre envían entrenadores para proteger a los Chinchou en su viaje, pero ¿bastarán para detener al Equipo Rocket?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando el hogar de la familia de un entrenador es amenazado por los Corsola que viven cerca, Ash y sus amigos deben rescatarlos... ¡Y quizás Misty al fin pueda atrapar al Corsola que ha estado buscando!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de que nuestros héroes pierden un ferry, conocen a un buzo, quien les ofrece llevarlos a la siguiente isla... ¡Pero pronto se distraen con los cuentos del tesoro a bordo de un barco hundido!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando no están compitiendo en la Copa Remolino, Ash y Misty tratan de ayudar a un joven entrenador cuyo Octillery ha sido rechazado por sus amigos Remoraid tras su evolución.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Luego de ganar las rondas preliminares, Ash y Misty enfrentan a oponentes formidables en la Copa Remolino. ¡Mientras tanto, el trío del Equipo Rocket tiene el objetivo de robar el premio del torneo!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Es la segunda ronda de la Copa Remolino, ¡y Ash y Misty deben enfrentarse uno al otro! ¿Quién saldrá victorioso? ¿Y el plan del Equipo Rocket para distraer a la policía tendrá éxito?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes tienen el deber de proteger una aldea de los merodeadores que amenazan con huir con los Diglett que viven ahí. Y gracias a una deliciosa cena, el Equipo Rocket también se ofrece a ayudar.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.sub-title: El robo de las alas plateadas
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes conocen a un joyero que les cuenta la leyenda de la cuarta isla Remolino… ¡Y pronto se encuentra envuelto en un plan del Equipo Rocket!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Mientras dos grupos de villanos del Equipo Rocket salen a capturar al Pokémon legendario Lugia, Ash encuentra a su viejo amigo Richie y a su compañero, ¡un Pikachu llamado Sparky!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: El pequeño Lugia llamado Silver ha caído en las manos de Butch y Cassidy del Equipo Rocket, y con la ayuda de Richie, Ash debe ganar la confianza del Lugia adulto antes de caer en la misma trampa.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Mientras Ash trata de rescatar a dos Lugia del Equipo Rocket, ¡Ash y sus amigos son hechos prisioneros! Ahora, deben hallar una forma de escapar... ¡Y de liberar también a los Pokémon capturados!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Ash y sus amigos van en un avión hacia Ciudad Olivine cuando quedan atrapados en una terrible tormenta que también atrapa al globo del Equipo Rocket. Tendrán que trabajar juntos para aterrizar a salvo... ¿Pero podrán hacerlo?

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Después de varias interrupciones, incluyendo otro Plan del Equipo Rocket, la batalla de Ash contra Jasmine en el Gimnasio Olivine finalmente está en marcha.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando los Pokémon del laboratorio del profesor Oak en Kanto no se llevan bien, el profesor le pide a Ash que mande a su Bulbasaur al laboratorio para que lo ayude a mantener la paz.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: En Ciudad Ecruteak, nuestros héroes encuentran a su amiga Sakura y su recién evolucionado Espeon. Sakura y sus hermanas se preparan para una competencia de baile, pero el Equipo Rocket acecha, tratando de robar a sus Pokémon…

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando nuestros héroes investigan un repentino repique de campanas, descubren que las Campanas de Cristal, que solo repican cuando el Pokémon legendario Ho-Oh regresa, no están. El investigador Eusine parece saber algo...

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando Ash encuentra a su viejo rival Gary preparándose para inscribir a su Arcanine en una carrera, decide competir también. Pero primero, tendrá que alejar al Equipo Rocket de la Guardería Pokémon.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando los huevos Pokémon de Ash desaparecen, nuestros héroes piden la ayuda de una desafortunada Oficial Jenny. Pronto se dan cuenta de que, si quieren recuperar el huevo, tendrán que buscarlo ellos mismos.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: El momento por fin ha llegado: ¡Un Phanpy ha salido del Huevo Pokémon de Ash! El pequeño Pokémon está lleno de energía y pronto sale volando... ¡Con nuestros héroes y el Equipo Rocket detrás!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Jessie, James y Meowth toman un tiempo para lamer sus heridas y soñar con robar a Pikachu para gloria del Equipo Rocket. Tras un encuentro con un explorador del Equipo Rocket, parece que estos sueños estallan ante sus ojos.

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cuando una espesa niebla interrumpe el viaje de nuestros héroes, una niña y su Ninetales los invitan a descansar en una mansión cercana... ¡Donde Brock y su anfitrión inician un romance que podría resultar fantasmal!

programme.title: Pokémon: La búsqueda del maestro
programme.desc: Cerca de Mr. Mortar, nuestros héroes encuentran a un entrenador que intenta contener los impulsos de su Tyrogue. Pero cuando el Equipo Rocket se entromete, ¿podrá salvar al problemático Tyrogue de las garras de los villanos?

programme.sub-title: Goodbye, Morioh – The Heart of Gold

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind
programme.desc: Amid the gritty beauty of Neapolis, the Joestar lineage lives on in Giorno Giovanna. After sidestepping long-term Joestar ally Koichi Hirose, Giorno must contend with two powerful Mafia gangsters, Leaky Eye Lucca and the enigmatic Bruno Bucciarati.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Eager to identify Leaky Eye Luca’s attacker, Bucciarati confronts Giorno and unleashes a Stand attack to dismantle him piece by piece. But Giorno counters with his Stand Golden Wind, surprising not just his adversary, but also himself.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
programme.sub-title: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
programme.desc: Determined to join the mafia gang Passione, altruistic Giorno is introduced by Bucciarati to the grotesquely corpulent Polpo, an incarcerated capo who tests Giorno’s loyalty with a simple but bizarrely lethal test involving a lighter and its flame.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Plodding amid the dusky shadows of a peaceful piazza is Polpo’s macabre Stand, which assails any who dare witness the reigniting of the lighter. Giorno deciphers its method of attack, but is soon staring death in the face as Koichi comes to his aid.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Find Polpo's Fortune!
programme.desc: While word of the high-ranking capo Polpo’s alleged suicide sparks astonishment and speculation in the crime syndicate Passione, Giorno is inducted into Bucciarati’s eclectic mafia family. The only problem now is the vast fortune seemingly up for grabs.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Sailing to the Isle of Capri to recover Polpo’s estate, Bucciarati and team are ambushed by a stealthy enemy Stand that deflates them into rubber-like human pelts. Abbacchio, however, thinks he can find his comrades and reluctantly activates his Stand.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Having beheaded their captor by zipper, the team learns its plan has been leaked to Zucchero’s cohort, who is lying in wait on Capri. With fish and gun, Giorno and Mista swim to the island to beat the boat and weed out their assassin-in-waiting.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: As Mista closes in on Sale, all signs seem to point to an easy kill. If only it weren’t for the truck hurtling up a mountainous Capri road stuck to his hand or Sale’s power to freeze all objects, gunman Mista would be celebrating over his enemy’s corpse.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.sub-title: The First Mission From the Boss
programme.desc: Within arm’s reach of Polpo’s fortune, Bucciarati and team meet the unassuming Pericolo, a capo who has come to accept the treasure. In presenting the loot, Bucciarati is bestowed not only the rank of capo but also an immense duty: protect Trish Una.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hitman Team
programme.desc: After an encounter with the Hitman Team’s Formaggio, Narancia is left wondering why the world is quickly transforming around him. Narancia hunts down his assailant with a hail of bullets as Formaggio tries to understand his attacker’s tracking skills.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Narancia is unshakable as he uses firepower and CO2 detection to survive Formaggio’s body-shrinking attack. Even beneath a spider’s fangs inside Formaggio’s bottle, Narancia reveals not Trish’s whereabouts but the bullet holes his Stand has left behind.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.sub-title: The Second Mission From the Boss
programme.desc: Giorno, Abbacchio and Fugo travel to Pompeii to find a hidden key pivotal in their protection of Trish. Facing the trio, however, is more than the lonely remains of ancient Roman villas and colonnades. Fugo spots an odd figure in an even stranger mirror.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Illuso has pulled Fugo into his mirror world as Abbacchio rushes to retrieve the key, despite Giorno’s stern advice. But Abbacchio cannot escape a similar fate, leaving him and later Giorno to resort to self-mutilation in favor of death by laceration.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.sub-title: Special Episode Golden Wind The Beginning
programme.desc: Delve into the deadly battles that mold Giorno into an indispensable member of the Passione gang as he and his allies fight to protect Trish and themselves against outlandish acts of violence by members of the Hitman team.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Ready to escort Trish by train, the gang finds on the platform a lone turtle lingering by the drinking fountain, just as the boss instructed. But Bucciarati is stumped—departure is imminent, the enemy is closing in, and the cryptic key appears useless.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Bucciarati and gang hide inside a turtle aboard their train hurtling toward Florence as Mista fights to keep Pesci's body-piercing fish hook from ensnaring his brain. Prosciutto, meanwhile, has released his Stand, rapidly aging everyone on board.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: To save his squad, Bucciarati risks all by grabbing hold of Prosciutto and hurling himself off the speeding train, only to be saved by Pesci’s hook. Now, as Pesci savagely fishes for his victim’s heart, Bucciarati’s resolve reaches stunning heights.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Bucciarati and crew head to Venice by car, after a near-death encounter with Pesci. Unbeknownst to them, Melone from the Hitman Team has created an atomizing ancillary Stand from Bruno’s blood and the body of an unsuspecting female train passenger.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Giorno fights transmutation with transmutation as he weaponizes his own severed hand and imbues inanimate objects with life against Melone’s baby Stand. Giorno and team now must learn that the road ahead to Santa Lucia train station is paved with ice.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Ghiaccio's Stand, White Ice is able to envelop him like a bodysuit and able to freeze everything around him to extremely low temperatures. Giorno and Mista somewhat make it to Venice, despite being partially frozen by Ghiaccio...

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.sub-title: The Final Mission From the Boss
programme.desc: By revealing to each other a fearless embrace of the unknown, Giorno and Mista emerge victorious against Ghiaccio. Now, a single member of Bruno’s group must face a single bell tower, a single elevator shaft, and a single menacing task.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: In the crypt of a Venetian church, Bruno discovers not only the brutal truth behind the Boss’s true intentions but also the unstoppable Stand power he wields, a power that leaves Bruno in a pool of blood and in a moral quandary.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Peer into the complex personal pasts of Bucciarati and his fellow gang members, and uncover the thread that unites this diverse group of fighters into a single team and single expression of resolve.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Bruno and team, now self-chosen traitors, learn from Trish during a moment of calm at a Venetian café a trip to Sardegna is vital. Chaos, then, erupts as Narancia loses his tongue and ability to speak the truth.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: As Giorno is teleported between puddles with Squalo’s shark attached firmly to his jugular, Narancia tries to sniff out the perpetrator using his CO2 tracer but is inhibited by Tiziano’s tongue-fusing Stand, frustrating himself and Bruno’s team.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Bruno et al head to Marco Polo airport to venture to Sardegna to discover the truth behind Trish’s father. On the tarmac, however, is a swollen, neckless Stand user who, the team discovers while airborne, is linked to the freshly severed fingers onboard

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: The Light at the End of the Tunnel
programme.desc: Pegasus's hired duelist Panik cheats Mai of all her star chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when Panik's Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes Panik - "I'll finish you in three turns." Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus. Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba's Blue Eyes White Dragon and Joey's Red Eyes Black Dragon holds the answers!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bandit Keith's gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith's zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey's last-ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizard card, fails against Bandit Keith's zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers with all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus's castle on the line!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or is his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, the Summoned Skull, and the Red-Eyes Black Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of the Gate Guardian.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba summons the Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put the Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi's heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Having lost his star chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Tea bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra star chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba's soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people's minds.

programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus's Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba's soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba!

programme.desc: Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus's secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!
